description: This file defines the UseMcpToolTool class, a specialized tool for executing MCP server tools within a larger application. It includes methods for parameter validation, tool execution, status reporting, and handling partial inputs. The class interacts with MCP servers, manages user approval, and processes tool responses.

classes.name: UseMcpToolTool
classes.description: A class extending BaseTool to facilitate executing MCP server tools with validation, user approval, and response processing.

methods.name: parseLegacy
methods.description: Parses legacy parameters, returning server name, tool name, and arguments.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main method to validate parameters, request user approval, and execute the MCP tool.

methods.name: handlePartial
methods.description: Handles partial input blocks for the tool, preparing and asking for user confirmation.

methods.name: validateParams
methods.description: Validates input parameters, including JSON parsing for arguments.

methods.name: validateToolExists
methods.description: Checks if the specified MCP server and tool exist and are enabled.

methods.name: sendExecutionStatus
methods.description: Sends status updates about MCP tool execution to the webview.

methods.name: processToolContent
methods.description: Processes the content of the tool's response for display.

methods.name: executeToolAndProcessResult
methods.description: Executes the MCP tool, handles status updates, and processes the result.
